:::{#def-intercept-term}
#### Intercept term

When a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) is written as [terms](algebra-sums.qmd#def-term) added together,
its **intercept term** is the [term](algebra-sums.qmd#def-term) with no factor of the [input](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-argument).
When every other term has a factor of the input,
the intercept (@def-intercept) of the function is this term.

:::
